title: Process steps
description: What happens once a visitor gets in touch, in order: a section heading, an optional line of intro, and three numbered steps side by side at wide width, each a heading that starts with its number and one short line. On a phone the steps stack.

Heading.purpose: The section's h2: what the steps are, in a few words, such as How it works.

Intro.purpose: One line on where the steps lead, such as from the first call to the finished job. Leave it out when the heading says enough.

Step 1 heading.purpose: The step's h3: its number, a full stop and a space, then what happens, in a few words, such as 1. Get in touch. After repeat or omit, renumber every step's heading so the numbers count up from 1 in order.

Step 1 text.purpose: One plain line on what happens in this step, or what the customer does. No price, time or promise unless the site owner gave it.
